prompts.request: One seamless top-down pixel-art indoor palace marble floor field. Low-saturation warm ivory and cool pearl-gray large rectangular slabs, sparse pale gray veins, tidy narrow joints, horizontal staggered rows, flat even ambient lighting, no perspective/shadows/objects/margins/text. Intended uniform64x64 reduction and16x16 splitting; all edges should tile.

One seamless top-down pixel-art outdoor courtyard paving field. Muted beige-gray limestone rectangular flagstones in staggered rows, softly weathered edges and sparse tiny chips; matte low-saturation stone, distinct from polished indoor marble. Flat even light, no perspective/shadows/grass/objects/margins/text. Intended uniform64x64 reduction and16x16 splitting; all edges should tile.

sampling: Uniform1254x1254 to64x64; each full material field repeats with fixed world XY phase. No independent rotation of individual16px cells. Native-size maps and2x2 repeat sheets visually checked.
compression: Atlas oxipng lossless. Originals preserved; reference byte budgets subordinate to visible quality.
